## Summary

When deserializing Pydantic v2 models, `_create_msgpack_ext_hook` instantiates classes via `cls(**kwargs)`. For models defining `Field(alias=...)` without `populate_by_name=True`, Pydantic's `__init__` ignores the unaliased key exported by `model_dump()`, silently falling back to the field default.

This change updates the `EXT_PYDANTIC_V2` hook in `langgraph/checkpoint/serde/jsonplus.py` to attempt `cls.model_validate(tup[2], by_name=True)` before falling back to `cls(**tup[2])` and `cls.model_construct(**tup[2])`.

## Changes
- `libs/checkpoint/langgraph/checkpoint/serde/jsonplus.py`: evaluate `model_validate(..., by_name=True)` in `_create_msgpack_ext_hook`.
- `libs/checkpoint/tests/test_jsonplus.py`: add `test_msgpack_pydantic_v2_field_alias_roundtrip` covering direct models with default aliased fields, nested models, and legacy msgpack payloads.

## Verification
- `uv run pytest tests/` (232 passed, 16 skipped)
- `uv run ruff check .` (passed)
- `uv run ruff format --check .` (passed)
- `uv run ty check .` (passed)

Fixes #9343
